session.title: Project review
session.leaveDescription: Your attempt is kept in this browser tab. Unconfirmed answers do not update your schedule. Return to this project to resume or retry an uncertain request.
session.restart: Reload queue and start a fresh attempt
session.emptyDescription: The current queue is empty. Daily limits, due times and project visibility determine what is available.
session.audioUnavailable: Audio unavailable. Retry playback, give up, or exit; no answer is revealed.
session.timing: Answer time: {duration} ms · Server elapsed: {elapsed} ms

errors.recoverable: The request could not be completed. Retry safely; a pending answer or rating will be sent unchanged.
errors.unusable: No usable exercise is available for this card. Nothing was skipped or graded. Retry after adding suitable content, or exit.
errors.expired: This attempt has expired. Reload the queue to start a fresh attempt; no unconfirmed answer updates your schedule.
errors.stale: This attempt conflicts with the latest study state. Reload the queue instead of applying an outdated answer.
errors.unavailable: This attempt or project content is no longer available. Check project access and visibility, then reload the queue.
errors.storage: This tab cannot safely save the review session. Enable session storage and retry before continuing.
errors.hintUnavailable: No hint is available for this exercise. You can still answer or give up.

study.utcNotice: Daily limits and history use UTC dates. Forecasts include overdue cards today and existing scheduled reviews only, not simulated future reviews. Dashboard totals deduplicate shared cards; project counts can overlap.
study.examPacing: {remaining} new senses · {days} study windows left · suggested {suggested}/day. Capacity: {capacity}; capacity before the 7-day buffer: {buffer}.
study.examPast: The exam time has passed. Choose a future exam date or clear it.
study.examImpossible: The remaining new senses cannot fit before the exam at the current daily limit.
study.examBuffer: The seven-day revision buffer is at risk. Consider adjusting the plan.
study.emptyDescription: Create a project and select some senses to start learning.
study.zeroLimit: A zero limit pauses that category; a blank review cap is unlimited.
study.queueEmpty: No cards ready in this plan
study.queueEmptyDescription: You may have reached today's limits, have no selected senses, or be waiting for the next scheduled review.
study.retentionHelp: Enter a number strictly between 0 and 1, for example 0.9 for 90%.
study.retentionNotice: This setting applies to your future scheduling across all projects. Saving it does not rewrite existing cards or review history.
study.retentionValidation: Enter a finite number greater than 0 and less than 1.
study.orderNotice: Load all visible selected senses in project-tree order to create a new priority draft. This is not a readback of saved priority. Saving replaces the visible priority order, including senses outside today's capped queue. Already learned senses stay learned; hidden slots are preserved by the server.

exercise.choiceShortcuts: Focus choices: 1–4 select, Enter submits. H requests a hint outside text fields. Escape requests exit. Space on the exercise frame requests audio.
exercise.typedShortcuts: Enter submits. Type normally in the answer field (including H and Space). Escape outside text fields requests exit.
exercise.ratingShortcuts: Focus ratings: 1–4 select, Enter or Space confirms.

preview.title: Exercise controls
preview.prompt: Choose the word meaning a financial institution.
preview.recallPrompt: Type the English word for a financial institution.
preview.recall: Typed recall · incorrect feedback and rating override
preview.simulation: Preview only: fixed feedback simulates a server response; production components never grade answers.

addWord.title: Add word
addWord.placeholder: Enter a word, phrase, or inflected form
addWord.noMatches: No matches. Check the spelling or try another form.
addWord.added: Added to this project. Adding again is safe; existing entries are reused.

jobs.title: Background jobs
jobs.failedHelp: This background job failed. Your word is still added; you can keep using the project.
jobs.pollError: Could not check this job. Retry to refresh its status.
jobs.preview: Background job states (preview only; no polling)

lemmaDetail.resetConfirm: Remove all your customized fields for this item? The shared dictionary is unchanged.
lemmaDetail.invalidNote: Enter a note between 1 and 10,000 characters.

audio.error: Audio could not be played. Try again.

preview.title: Word components
preview.note: A bank can be a place or the side of a river.

preferences.themeAction: Theme: {mode}. Switch to the next theme

auth.changeRequired: Change your temporary password before continuing.

admin.protectionNotice: You cannot disable or demote yourself. The last enabled administrator is protected.
admin.confirmNotice: Apply this action to {username}? A password reset replaces their password; share the new temporary password securely.
admin.passwordNotice: Share this password securely with {username}. They must change it at sign-in. It is shown only until you close this dialog.
admin.copyFailed: Could not copy the password. Select it and copy manually.

projects.emptyHint: Create a project to organize your vocabulary.
projects.deleteNotice: Permanently delete {name} and its project memberships? This cannot be undone. Your words are kept.
projects.treeHiddenHint: Restore hidden items here. Items hidden by an ancestor become visible only after that ancestor is restored.
projects.treeEmpty: No words in this project yet.
projects.treeEmptyHint: Add a word to start building your vocabulary.
projects.treeNoVisible: No visible words on this page.
projects.numberValidation: Enter a non-negative whole number within the safe integer range.
projects.planNotice: Saving replaces the complete study plan. Clear the review limit or exam date to remove it. Dates use your local time.

errors.study_too_large: This project or learning history exceeds planning limits. Reduce the selection or contact an administrator.

errors.admin_user_not_found: This user no longer exists. Refresh the list.
errors.admin_self_protected: You cannot disable or demote yourself.
errors.admin_last_admin: The last enabled administrator cannot be disabled or demoted.

errors.transport: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
